name: ChuSingura 46+1 Wacchi to Onii-chan no Love Love Nagaya Seikatsu
original_name: ChuSingura46+1 わっちとお兄ちゃんのラブラブ長屋生活
source:
Shinpachirou failed to stop the raid of the forty-seven ronin and returned to Naoto on the verge of death. Her injuries healed as they spent a quiet life together. As spring arrived, he asked if she would like to live in Edo, to which she readily agreed. However, they were not samurai but rather ronin, and without money, they have no jobs. Still, they believed that they’ll be able to figure things out when they got there.They found a place in a cheap longhouse and she explained to him the various lifestyles and customs of the Edo period, much of which was a still a commonplace in the present age. Their loving cohabitation true story begins now.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/11/21/november-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
新八郎未能阻止四十七浪人的袭击，在死亡边缘回到了直人身边。他们一起过着平静的生活，她的伤痊愈了。春天到来时，他问她是否愿意住在江户，她欣然同意。然而，他们不是武士，而是浪人，没有钱就没有工作。尽管如此，他们相信到达那里后就能解决问题。他们在一间廉价的长屋里找到了一个地方，她向他解释了江户时代的各种生活方式和习俗，其中很多在当今时代仍然是司空见惯的。他们恩爱同居的真实故事现在开始了。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/11/21/november-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~！[/url]]
